title: drymocallis reflexa
intro: Drymocallis reflexa, commonly known as sticky cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Drymocallis reflexa include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent, making it useful for wound healing and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
